compiled_state.title: Add calibration-report.sh query subcommand routing plus intents-with-low-kill-rate and intents-without-coverage subs
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying:
- dd-1: calibration-report.sh query intents-with-low-kill-rate produces output matching its documented schema for a dry-run input fixture
- dd-2: calibration-report.sh query intents-without-coverage produces output matching its documented schema for a dry-run input fixture
- dd-5 (partial): query sub schemas documented in --help output

Add query subcommand routing to plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh:

  calibration-report.sh query <sub> [--fixture=<dir>] [--dry-run]

Route to handler functions based on <sub> value. Implement:

  query intents-with-low-kill-rate: lists bug intents where mutation kill rate < threshold (default 50%). Output schema: list of {intent_id, kill_rate, bug_count}. Uses pre-aggregated mutation data from mutation-history tracking ticket.

  query intents-without-coverage: lists bug intents with no mutation test covering them. Output schema: list of {intent_id, test_coverage_count}. Uses mutation-history data.

For fixture mode (--fixture=<dir>): read from fixture files instead of live ticket query. Requires tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/sample-bugs.json for bug data; mutation data from --fixture dir if present.

Create tests/scripts/test-calibration-query-intents.sh exercising both subs with --fixture mode.

## Testing Mode
RED — write fixture-driven tests first; they fail because query subcommand does not exist.

## Acceptance Criteria
- query routing exists in calibration-report.sh — Verify: grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*query\)' plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh
- intents-with-low-kill-rate exits 0 with fixture — Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh query intents-with-low-kill-rate --fixture=tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs --dry-run
- intents-without-coverage exits 0 with fixture — Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh query intents-without-coverage --fixture=tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs --dry-run
- Tests pass — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-calibration-query-intents.sh
- Test file is executable — Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-calibration-query-intents.sh

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh — Edit
- tests/scripts/test-calibration-query-intents.sh — Create
